entities.summary: Indigenous Uprising, a transformative movement in Ecuador (1986–2005). Emerged from CONAIE founded — 1986; most powerful indigenous movement in the Americas. Catalyzed Levantamiento Indígena paralyzes Ecuador — June 1990 and Jamil Mahuad.
